evidence: Manually read complete source and exact caller transaction chain; each symbol individually reasoned. No execution.

symbols.reasoning: Loads other active user hash tuples and sequentially verifies candidate against each salted hash, throws on match. Salt means equal PIN has different stored hash; no DB hash uniqueness proof. No transaction/anchor lock, so distinct-target concurrent checks may both pass. No plaintext credential read/log. CPU work O(active users*KDF cost), no cancellation inside Any; strength guard happens later in Hash, not here. Existing parent security lead, not new finding.
symbols.outputs: User creation ID/replay flag, credential update or collision exception
symbols.trust_boundaries: Actual users_manage for create/admin reset; current-secret proof self-change; owner/explicit-permission guards. Session binding external, no credentials reported.
symbols.database: Single Save for writes, no serialization around cross-user uniqueness. Same-ID replay is not distinct-user collision protection.
symbols.performance: Active-user KDF scan O(user count*hash cost); no benchmark or CPU cancellation test.
symbols.duplicates_conflicts: Existing parent security owns PIN/owner concurrency and role-derived capability candidates; no duplicate promoted finding.
symbols.issues_hypotheses: Source-only limits on concurrent admission, role versus explicit grants and session revocation preserved. No validated exploit or authentication attempt.
symbols.tests_missing: Self current-PIN control, owner admin refusal, different-target concurrent PIN create/change, inactive/reactivation, first-owner concurrent keys, explicit grant subset, replay and no secret audit.
symbols.verified_callers_callees: Full Change24-65/Create23-95/Checker16-23 and domain UserManagementRules/PinHasher read; Checker->Verify, new Hash->AssertValidPin. No DB/auth execution.
